summary: Instrument approaches at Cumbernauld Airport require a pre-booked approach time slot.
text:
FLIGHT PROCEDURES - INSTRUMENT APPROACH PROCEDURES (IAP)
THE IAP MUST HAVE A WRITTEN PRE-BOOKED APPROACH TIME SLOT FROM
CUMBERNAULD AIRPORT WEBSITE WWW.CUMBERNAULDAIRPORT.ORG WHICH MUST
BE ADHERED TO. UK AIP EGPG AD 2.22-4/B REFERS.
